div.head: Ine 6.3
div.ab: Gif ðonne on gafolgildon huse oððe on gebures gefeohte, CXX scll' to wite gesylle ⁊ þæm gebure VI scll'.
Gif ðonne on gafolgeldan huse oððe on gebures gefeohte, CXX scill. to wite geselle ⁊ þam gebure VI scill.
Si autem in gauelgilda (id est in gablum reddentis) domo fiat uel in gebures, XXX sol. culpa iudicetur, et ipsi geburo VI solid.
Gif ðonne on gefolgeldan huse oððe on gebures gefeohte, CXX sciƚƚ to wite geselle ⁊ þæm gebure vi sciƚƚ.
If he should fight in the house of a renter or a farmer, let him pay 120 shillings as a fine and 6 shillings to the farmer.
If, however, he fights in the house of a taxpayer or of a gebur, he shall pay 120 shillings as a fine, and 6 shillings to the gebur.
Wenn [er] aber im Hause eines Abgabenpflichtigen oder in [dem] eines Bauern ficht, zahle er [dem König] 120 [30] Schill. zur Strafe und dem Bauern 6 Schill.
But if [he] fights in the house of a rent-paying man or in [that] of a peasant, let him pay [the king] 120 [30] shillings as a fine and the peasant 6 shillings.
